name: CRISPR-Cas9 gene editing
known_mechanism_before: Bacterial adaptive immunity via CRISPR-Cas system; Cas9 is a nuclease guided by RNA
missing_combination: Recognition that Cas9's RNA-guided DNA cleavage is programmable for arbitrary sequences in eukaryotic cells
actual_breakthrough_mechanism: Cas9 + designed guide RNA = programmable DNA cleavage in any cell type

name: mRNA vaccines
pre_discovery_sources: mRNA cancer vaccine trials (2010s, limited success)
known_mechanism_before: Modified mRNA can be delivered to cells; lipid nanoparticles can encapsulate nucleic acids; viral spike proteins trigger immune response
missing_combination: Recognition that nucleoside-modified mRNA + lipid nanoparticle = stable, non-immunogenic, deliverable vaccine platform
actual_breakthrough_mechanism: Nucleoside-modified mRNA encoding spike protein + lipid nanoparticle delivery = vaccine with >95% efficacy

name: Lithium-ion battery
hidden_future_sources: Yoshino patent (1985, but significance not recognized until commercialization)
known_mechanism_before: LiCoO2 can intercalate lithium; graphite can intercalate lithium; lithium metal batteries are unsafe
missing_combination: Recognition that LiCoO2 cathode + graphite anode = safe, reversible, high-energy battery
actual_breakthrough_mechanism: LiCoO2 cathode + graphite anode + non-aqueous electrolyte = rechargeable Li-ion battery

name: PCR (Polymerase Chain Reaction)
known_mechanism_before: DNA polymerase extends primers; heat denatures DNA; thermophilic bacteria have heat-stable enzymes
missing_combination: Recognition that thermal cycling + thermostable polymerase = exponential DNA amplification
actual_breakthrough_mechanism: Thermal cycling (denature/anneal/extend) + Taq polymerase = exponential DNA amplification

name: Graphene
pre_discovery_sources: Thermodynamic argument that 2D crystals are unstable (Landau-Peierls)
known_mechanism_before: Graphite is layered carbon; theory says 2D crystals are thermodynamically unstable; carbon nanotubes are rolled graphene
missing_combination: Recognition that the thermodynamic argument is wrong for supported 2D crystals + mechanical exfoliation can isolate single layers
actual_breakthrough_mechanism: Mechanical exfoliation of graphite produces stable single-layer carbon (graphene) on substrate

name: Transformer architecture (Attention is All You Need)
known_mechanism_before: RNNs process sequences sequentially (slow, vanishing gradients); attention mechanisms improve seq2seq; self-attention has been used in some models
missing_combination: Recognition that self-attention alone (no recurrence) + positional encoding + multi-head attention = better, faster, more parallelizable architecture
actual_breakthrough_mechanism: Self-attention + positional encoding + multi-head attention + feed-forward layers = Transformer (no recurrence needed)

name: Deep learning ImageNet breakthrough (AlexNet)
known_mechanism_before: CNNs exist but are shallow; GPUs exist for graphics; ImageNet exists but hasn't been used for deep training; SVMs dominate vision
missing_combination: Recognition that deep CNN + GPU + ImageNet + ReLU + dropout = breakthrough performance
actual_breakthrough_mechanism: Deep CNN (8 layers) + GPU training + ImageNet (1M images) + ReLU + dropout = 15.3% error (vs 26.2% next best)

name: Penicillin
known_mechanism_before: Bacteria cause infections; chemical antiseptics exist but are tissue-toxic; some molds inhibit bacterial growth (observed but not characterized)
missing_combination: Recognition that a mold contaminant produces a diffusible antibacterial substance that is non-toxic to tissue
actual_breakthrough_mechanism: Penicillium mold produces penicillin, which inhibits bacterial cell wall synthesis without harming human cells

name: Monoclonal antibodies
known_mechanism_before: Antibodies are specific; B-cells produce antibodies; myeloma cells grow indefinitely; cell fusion is possible
missing_combination: Recognition that fusing antibody-producing B-cells with immortal myeloma cells = unlimited production of specific antibodies
actual_breakthrough_mechanism: B-cell + myeloma cell fusion = hybridoma that produces monoclonal antibodies indefinitely

name: Checkpoint immunotherapy (anti-PD-1)
known_mechanism_before: PD-1 is a T-cell receptor that suppresses immune response; CTLA-4 blockade works in melanoma; cancer vaccines have failed
missing_combination: Recognition that blocking PD-1 (the brake) rather than activating immune response (the gas) = effective cancer immunotherapy
actual_breakthrough_mechanism: Anti-PD-1 antibody removes T-cell inhibition, enabling immune system to attack tumors
